info.title: FlightDeck portal API — feature 004 delta
info.description: What feature 004 adds to FlightDeck's own API (served at /api/flightdeck/v1). The domain, mutation and capability endpoints of features 001 to 003 are unchanged and are not repeated here.

get.summary: One reading of the whole instrument cluster.
get.description: Answers every instrument in one call so that N instruments are not N requests per second. The sliding window is kept by the client and is never persisted (RN-FD-21). Availability of each instrument comes from the capability map; no caller tests the instance version.

get.summary: State and, when finished, value of a fired asynchronous platform task.
get.description: FlightDeck reads the platform's handle from the 202 response's LOCATION header and polls it through the dialect layer. The caller never sees the platform's path.

mode.description: The transport in use, shown on screen. Polling is the only transport: the official API offers no streaming endpoint, and a FlightDeck-owned one would poll the platform on the server behind a long-lived connection with no observable difference (spec FR-020a).

resources.description: Seize table from GET /v2/monitor/dashboard/system-resources, typed from the observed fields only (research R3).

value.description: Absent only when the instrument is unavailable; never cleared while a refresh is in flight.

scope.description: What the number measures, for example the container host.

reason.description: Why the instrument is unavailable, from the capability map.

lastValueAt.description: When the value on screen was read.

stale.description: True when the value is older than the refresh interval. The value stays on screen; staleness is stated, not hidden (RN-FD-32).

message.description: The platform's own failure text, shown beside the last known value, never in place of it.

managerStatus.description: From GET /v2/task/manager, so a suspended manager is stated rather than read as every task being idle.

TaskRows.description: Rows of GET /domains/tasks/task. The list is composed: GET /v2/tasks plus one read of GET /v2/task/history grouped by TaskId, because the platform ignores that operation's id parameter and answers the whole instance's history (feature 004 research R7).

history.description: Bounded band of recent results, most recent first, so an intermittent failure is visible without opening the detail (RN-FD-17).
